Just wanted to start this of about fancy rats. They have a bad name but are seriously misunderstood.. Will add some more stuff tomorrow..
Pretty Fancy Rats, some information and pictures, and any sits you might have about your experiences.

Rats have a bad name, people think they are dirty and carry diseases, but that is their sewer rat cousins. Fancy Rats are different theyare a lot cleaner and carry few or most no diseases at all.

Imgur Imgur

Here are two pictures of some of my boys (bucks) that are about 7 months old now. As you can see they are clean. They can eat almost the same amount of food humans can, and if allowed to will steal your food off your plate right under you your eyes..

Fancy rats need a clean environment to live in.They are prone to a bacterial infection called Mycoplasmosis, which if left untreated can kill a rat very slowly. It affects the lungs, and basically destroys them. Then the rest of the other major organs can become infected as well. Aggressive antibiotic regimes are necessary to keep the infection controlled., This bacterial infection is present in all rats from birth but is activated by stress.

Getting a pet rat is not something that should be taken lightly, they can be extremely expensive if you have to take them to the vets. The initial expense would be for a large cage that would fit two rats because rats are sociable and need to have a companion. Personally, I would say get three just in case one of them dies and there are companions for the ones that are left. There is bedding, then large dishes or pots for them to use as a toilet. The comes the cage decorations. Things like ladders, and houses for them to sleep in. Dishes for food. That would be around £100 at least. Then you need to keep putting money away for vet bills.

Some more pictures of my rats, and of some I used to have :)

Imgur Imgur Imgur Imgur

This is another group of males I had, they wer a really nice group. :)

Rats love attention, so much so they have a reaction just like a cat, its called bruxing and boggling. The bruxing is them quickly and rhythmically grate their teeth and almost sounds like a purr, and at the same time if they are really happy they the rhythmically boggle their eyes which is called boggling. To the person that has never seen it before, it looks like their eyes are about to fall out.

In most cases, this is a happy response to being with the person they like and can sit quite happily for hours without stopping. They also have a funny swish/wriggle to their tal as well, it looks like wriggly worm, but that is a happy sign. Other things they like to do is hat we call dentistry, where some really like to clean the person's teeth. I am not so inclined to do it, but its also a good sign. There are lots of other things that I could post if you would like some more information. Oh, an important one is, light coloured rats that have red eyes. Racks dont have very good sight, most of they do is their sense of smell. They will mark their territory with little drops of urine, and also will pee a little bit on their owner. People look out for that because it tells them the rat is happu with everything.

There are also some occasions where they will rattle their teeth its more like a rapid click and sounds different to the bruxing around. That is usually a sign that they are not happy and could soon nip somebody. Also sometimes a rat will brux when there something wrong. Taken with their general demeanour, you will recognise this, and it means they arent feeling very well. They could be a time when have to get a vets visit. The funniest is when they are pinging around the room in happiness. Just like a new born lamb does. Thats a nice this to see.
